name: Stove Kraft Limited
summary: Stove Kraft Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of kitchen and home solutions in India and internationally. The company offers pressure cookers, cookware, cooktop, induction and infrared cooktops, chimney, and hobs; mixer grinders, wet grinders, nutri mixer, airfryer, airfryer + oven, coffee maker, cold press juicer, kettles, oven, pop up toaster, sandwich maker, rice cooker, and portable blender; and chopper, idiyappam maker, water bottles, lunch boxes, and kitchen tools. It also provides vaccuum cleaner, car solutions, flood mops, garment care, room heater, emergency lamps, and extension chord; hair dryer, trimmer, and massagers; lockers; and pedestal, mini, tower, and wall fan.
